name: Vrundavan Pure Veg
why_it_matters: Pure-veg eatery 190m from Theur Chintamani Vinayaka temple — the natural post-darshan lunch stop on the Astavinayak Pune-east leg (Theur is 30km east of Pune). Maharashtrian thali + modak are the orders. Most Astavinayak pilgrim groups eat here between Theur and Ranjangaon darshan.
insider_tip: Modak available daily (steamed; not just festival-only). Weekend pilgrim queues 12-2pm — eat at 11am or 3pm. Cash + UPI. Open 7am-9pm.
signature_address: Theur village, Haveli taluka, Pune district 412110

name: Green9 Restaurant & Bar
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor 4.4/5 — the only AC sit-down with a bar in Theur, useful for Pune-Theur day-trippers who want an evening that's not a pilgrim thali. Italian + Indo-Chinese broaden the menu for groups with kids + non-vegetarian appetites (despite the pilgrim-village context).
insider_tip: Evening dinner 7-10pm is the sweet spot; lunch is quieter than the Vrundavan rush. Cards + UPI.
signature_address: Theur village, near Chintamani temple, Pune district 412110

name: Sanskruti Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor 3.7/5, Indian + Asian + vegetarian-friendly — backup to Vrundavan when the pilgrim queue is long. The Indo-Chinese mains broaden the menu for kid travellers. Open 11am-10pm.
insider_tip: Veg biryani (₹250) is the under-the-radar lunch order. Cash + UPI. Weekends busy 12-2pm with Astavinayak tour groups.
signature_address: Theur village, near Chintamani temple, Pune district 412110
